facts.fact: DatacenterDynamics reports that the Government of Ghana opened a three-hall data center in Accra, built by its agency NITA with Alcatel and Huawei Technologies Ghana, which also offers colocation space to private enterprise; the article dates the opening to the week of its 2016-01-29 publication.

DatacenterDynamics reports that the government-opened NITA data center in Accra, with a secondary replica at KNUST in Kumasi, will provide Ghanaian government agencies with email, antivirus and document management systems; dated by the article's published date, as it gives no other date.

systems.system: National Data Centre secondary replica (KNUST, Kumasi)
